name: dsh-plugin-remote-fanout
description: A remote one-shot subagent provider: registers a second named provider on ctx.subagents whose children are real DSH agent turns on ANOTHER node, reached over ssh. The parent process spawns nothing locally but one ssh client; the child runs in its own engine process on the target machine.

scripts.verify: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/remote-script.js && node --check lib/ssh-transport.js && node --check lib/provider.js && node --test test/remote-script.test.mjs test/ssh-transport.test.mjs test/provider.test.mjs
